fullness-of-godhead.title: Oboseire Bwonka bw'Obogosani
fullness-of-godhead.summary: Tegereria guse Paul are na oboseire bwonka bw'Obogosani bwakorire morwe wa Yesu Kristo.

0.title: Obogosani mwa Kristo
0.explanation: Entango tegereirie nigo Egesomani egatari eng'ana y'ikireroya Obogosani. Paul agokora ogochire nti Obogosani owarigi mwa Kristo agosarachania eriaisia ekere. Egeirania ekio nikyo kiomokenyete mokomanya, n'eragere riego riekora mwoyo morere sirandite Yesu. Ego, Paul abereire ogokora erie Colossians: obosagereria bwa Obogosani mwa Kristo nobutakora tori oburi kihanda kana oburamererie. Egesengani kiarire kobwo kw'orerania gikonete kubere Obogosani okorere mwa Messiahi wake.
0.hook: Paul asokirie na Obogosani gokorera ne Yesu Kristo. Yesu enka agochire egento ego, ati: 'Tata ogwangererie mwa ng'ina ne akora emirimo ego.'

1.title: Tata ogwangererie
1.explanation: Yesu abwate abaisekere kobwo Tata ogwangererie mwa ng'ina nigo akora ebirimo. Amamura, ebisubio ne mategete yaye agokorani nigo Orogosani oragererie natikore ne Yesu arigania. Omwaremwa, Yesu akoraki na komanya ogosaboka ogw'Omwana owarigwete. Ebintu bine biretererie gosereria kobwo egento y'okangereria kw'Orogosani ne ebirimo ebionchire Kristo. Ebio nigo birora obw'osari ogoteka gemegosani.
1.hook: Yesu aikire kobwo Tata ogwangererie nigo omanya egento y'ebirimo. Colossians atobera Kristo ni image ekionchire y'Orogosani orabwire.

2.title: Image ekionchire
2.explanation: Paul agokora Kristo ni image y'Orogosani orabwire. Orogosani orabwire tagosiri Obogosani, atari kogotaine na bakorania baige; Yesu aratera okubwate. Mwomoko ego, Paul abwate kobwo Kristo abwate na relation ya kwobora creation ne okwara oria bororire bwabose. Ego nigo birikiria ekegento kigonche. Image y'Orogosani nigo image ya Kristo; obwate obosereria bw'Obogosani bunesi mwa ng'ina.
2.hook: Kristo aratera omanya Orogosani orabwire. Paul agokora kobwo image echarara: oboseire bwonka bwangererie mwa ng'ina.

3.title: Oboseire bwose
3.explanation: Paul agokora kobwo oboseire bwose bwashiborie ogwang'eria mwa Kristo, nogokobera ekire n'omoborere ochindori gotang'ana nomosacha wekwa kwe nkanda. Okangereria kw'Obogosani, ne obochire bwe obosacha bwa omonto omogusani omoke, biri mwa Mesia oyio yamogwa. Paul tagokora ekiro kiogosani kekomeire Yesu. Apostolic Oneness Theology ikobia onka Orogosani owarigi mwa Kristo. Colossians 2:9 abwate ogotobera kobwo oboseire bwose nibw'Obogosani bwangererie mu gikundi kemonto.
3.hook: Oboseire bwose bwangeirie mwa Kristo. Colossians 2:9 ataobora gotua obokebire, asaena kobwo oboseire noboseire bw'Obogosani bwangererie mu gikundi kemonto.

4.title: Oboseire bwose mu gikundi kemonto
4.explanation: Paul agokora gotari kobwate: oboseire bwose bw'Obogosani bwangererie mwa Kristo mu gikundi kemonto. Egotekia e Riteme ('Word') omowa Obogosani oragererie omonto; bosaire bwose tagotari ekio kiakobere kemonto omochando. Apostolic Oneness teaching igokoba Yesu ni Orogosani omonene ow'engererwe omonto omogusani. Eversi ogotari gotia ebisubio, obochire, kana ogosaboka kwe Yesu kuri mwana. Tagochoba gotia ebirengo byoima n'ekire ekigaririe ke Tata ne Omwana.
4.hook: Omogoro ogoseire gotuoka apa: oboseire bwose bw'Obogosani bwangererie mu Kristo. Korigwa nigo kegenderereria ekegento ke eriso oyo ribwate eng'ina Yesu.

name-of-jesus.title: Eina ria Yesu
name-of-jesus.summary: Rinde eina eretia enyama ritariomo, orogendereria, okobokera, na okobatiswa.

0.title: Eina eretia enyama rigendi
0.explanation: Matthew agotanga omoibi oye gose enyama keraiba Yesu chibore akaigwerera abanto bae obwanchani bwabwe. Eina riye rietagwa ritariogo na omwondo okorosa orogendereria riererie. Nirie ribori ogende erete, osweta ekeigeni yaya nigo goseria nigo Irakiria. Eirongoi ekeng’ene eretia gose abanto omoyoro Yesu ni bori omonyamete nigo amagasi God gotuma enyama egesenzi. Matthew agotanga orotanda rw'eenya Immanuel, 'Nyasae igwena nabwo,' abokania omodasari arorie agota rondereka obosendi bwa Nyasae bwagokora Yesu.
0.hook: Matthew akobokania eina Yesu na orogendereria rweye. John nigo abonseria guse orogendereria ryaya Yesu rionchomaga na eriori Nyasae (Father) eina rye.

1.title: Eina rya Father rionchomagwe
1.explanation: Yesu agokwana Father agokorokia abaisani ake ararora agosimbiriria ajongera erioma nge na abaja. Egitabo gi’Omorigiti, eina ria Nyasae ni obori obotaramanya obotakorianyora, obotabera odonge, amara, na obobosia, ntigo ekotari. Yesu anaba bonseria Father abokania, amemesia, na orogendereria rye eretia. Eng’wanse egokobokania Oneness, orwamo rwabereire orogendereria rwariongo sawan’ene eme Yesu. Ntariego ayaetwete noto ebitabo birikorokia 'eina ria Father’ rinosi J-E-S-U-S. Okonywa kwako ni okonyi okorabwate omokunda gwa Egitabo gi’Omorigiti giabaruara bagokora New Testament.
1.hook: Yesu agokwana agosimbiriria Father eina rye. Eng'ani Acts gikobokania abaisani ebeine orogendereria rwabereire nigo abokania ereta Yesu after resurrection.

2.title: Eina eretia orogendereria eng'ani
2.explanation: Peter agokwana orogendereria ntiri nigo rikore atari Yesu, nigo atera ntiriko abanto bose akora nigo okobwate eina eretia orogendereria. Akoboreria Yesu oyio oyariborie nigo abisikwa batarorera obekene nigo Nyasae agorengera. Ekiao ekemera ekobokereria Yesu, ntigo omokano klubatira eina rye. Nario nigo abaisani abakorania orogendereria, obatamiza, na obatisisa bosque begann Yesu Kristo. Eina eretia orogendereria nigo riegwa Yesu, ntiriko omwondo gose ekebwate ekwateta eina rye.
2.hook: Abaisani bakoresia ntiri eina eretia orogendereria. Philippians agosaria orogendereria gose kora orotambira bote ekebwate ekebwate yesia.

3.title: Eina riorosa eina riote
3.explanation: Paul agokwana Nyasae agoterete Yesu ching’ani na omote eina riote, nigo bateba bwanchani na omoeng’ano bwose. Abe ete ese ese edwe agochame, agochama, na agokwana Yesu Kristo ni Omwami. Eirimi eretia eiyo yenderekerwa Isaiah riba etererie ese ese edwe agochame LORD. Paul agokobokania eiya eretia ekiorosania Yesu, nigo endoka Nyasae Father. Eng’wanse ya Oneness yenda Yesu oyio ebwe ereta Nyasae yesia, nigo ikwate rerereria omorongoro omote na orotari orosa oboisane bwa Orwakristo Kristo omote.
3.hook: Eina ria Yesu riegwa eina riote, ese ese edwe agochama. Colossians agoteiriria ebwe ekebwate orogendereria oroteka omonto bwose emorote na emirimo.

4.title: Bosie okoina Yesu' eina
4.explanation: Paul agokwana abarwete barye, erinde bosie, amakunda gose emirimo, bosinde Yesu' eina, gokorania Nyasae Father kobore eiyo. Eina rye ni einyora omoso ekebwate eretia omorongoro Kristo bwose. Eyi etanore ogo bose egesigani riroreria ne amategeko ametanga, erinde amasano, amarerania, na amereke. Okokwania Yesu' eina kiarorori ebwe eng’ina ekegosera morogendereria, ekere na obwitoro bwe obwami.
4.hook: Bosie ekosete enyora Yesu' eina. Ekeng'eni kigendi ekobokania ere Yesu arangetie obatisa omonto okoei eina enirotari na ogotebia abaisani biye barikorania.

matthew-28-and-acts-2.title: Matthew 28:19 na Ebikorwa 2:38
matthew-28-and-acts-2.summary: Somera ebiragiro bi Yesu n'ogotimanyiya kogotebesa abakorere b’abatume hamwe.

0.title: Tembeeria eryangochie rimwe
0.explanation: Yesu amogota kerora ogotebesa buya m'erina eryangochie 'rya' Tate, Mosebe (Omwana) na Omoyoro (Omoyoni) Omoyagoro. Eki omotwe ogotamorire eyirira etienda ebaate eba abaire gotebeswa enaiga; ogotamorire irina ryangochie riri ogwatontore kana kumonyora obotebeso. Ebikorwa, abatumwa barengeete gotebesa morina rya Yesu omokristu. Ensomo y’ab'Oneness y'Abatumwa ekora eki kera igotanga gotegera ekiragiro n’Omatayo kokarigania amasomo, kobweya Yesu n’erina rya Nyasae ryosereire mokobere Mosebe. Eki kibereire gotebeteinse n'ogokoroma Abiaimente enia hamwe, korende oria erirango ryangochie wonyora.
0.hook: Yesu amogota ogotebesa morina riyangochie. Ogokora ogwa Luko omondi n'ogwingana komokogue erina riare korusuti omoturusu gwaevangelia.

1.title: Ekiragiro m’erina Rie
1.explanation: Luko akorire Yesu oria orambire, ogosacha okobori na okobokania ebibi bikowe_monine n’erina Rie m’amakungu gose, gokobwacha ku Jerusalem. Eki kirengerania ebiragiro bisae yesi ya Omatayo na koyangochia abachindani bae nabehindwa. Luko abwate gotumora gospel koborere aba gose, ase nk'ogotebe oboraita gotebeswa. Ekeri kyumera kobwate ebikorwa erinde besari ebya Yesu omokristo moruteko rwemabara.
1.hook: Luko abwate okobori na okobokania ebibi bikowe monine n’erina Rie. Ebikorwa 2 irora abatumwa babwate gotimanya ekiragiro ominto.

2.title: Abatumwa batomera ebirindani
2.explanation: Omondi obande bwuchire chimbweta ki, Petero asabira okoboria na gotebesa morina ria Yesu Kristo kobokania ebibi bikwe, omoteete n'obokoro bwa Omoyagoro (Holy Ghost). Eki nigo guchimboka obokora obwambere bwogotebesa okoreti Yesu atumire. Ensomo y’Ab'Oneness y'Abatumwa ekora eki kere abatumwa gotimanya ekiragiro kibereire n'erina rea Yesu risereire. Ebikorwa tibireta obotebeso bwonse bwategwa, ekoriso nigo obusacha bwa abatumwa n'ogotwerera korwa gospel.
2.hook: Petero asabira gotebesa morina ria Yesu Kristo. Chimbweta kitari, kweroria ko eki chiari chiari ekiegwa Pentecosti kana ekweri korende buyoni y’abatumwa.

3.title: Ekorisano egenda buya buya
3.explanation: Ebikorwa birora Abasamaria baate gotebeswa morina rya Omogaga Yesu, korende Omoyagoro tibandekire mbere Petero na Yohana batire. Ekeri kibere egendereria gotebesa n'okoreta Omoyagoro ekwekererania. Bonyora ko irina ria Yesu tibirekereire bato ba Jerusalem. Eki kyongia obusacha kw'ogokora abatumwa ekiragiro, korende Ebikorwa tibireta chingobera ekoriso y'ebitera vyonse omondi buya.
3.hook: Ekimisiye ky'Abasamaria kiyongeta gotebesa morina ria Omogaga Yesu. Ebikorwa 19 kirorera eki ne Paulo amateba abageni begochi gotebeswa komosese.

4.title: Ekoriso ekabumore omondi buya
4.explanation: Oga Efeso, abageni batarorete obotebeso bwa Yohana gotega Paulo nabwate amatebia Yesu na gotebeswa morina rya Omogaga Yesu. Luko abwate eki nigo obogotanga bwa Yohana nakobwete obonene n'obotebeso bwogororo. Eki ekoriso ekierire yesi Jerusalem na Samaria. Ensomo y'Ab'Oneness y'Abatumwa eyangochia obuyogani obwanake gotegera gotebesa morina rya Yesu, kobwate omondi n'etorere yesi Matthew 28:19, gose ebuchakora korwa amasomo gose, tire oboraita.
4.hook: Paulo abateba gotebesa morina rya Omogaga Yesu. Egetebo egwomotwe ekomereria enka ebirta ebihumane Ebikorwa, mongina gotebeswa ekomwaka n’amasomo amang’ana.

baptism-in-jesus-name.title: Obotumwa Mosoni bwa Yesu' Name
baptism-in-jesus-name.summary: Goka omongera ebisimi bi'obotukwa bwo obotumwa na oborere bwabwo Origwe o Ekiregoini n'amasafu.

0.title: Obotumwa bwa Risani Yesu
0.explanation: Yesu originate risani agokora aria eire ese gose okuo ase emakunde na okemo kebisimi ekororania ni Ebibiriria, na ko omonto arekererie na okumanya obore b'eng'wencha n'obotumwa bosoni bwi'Nyasae Etari. Erina riye rindi omokono rio Kristo ya kome kwomotwe, orire ochi ereta omoya oye. Ekinya mwa Emposito chwa yabeire Ekericho, yinche Yesu yatondeire. Okesochia obotumwa bwa Yesu origwe na egesimi gia Petero negoka buya ago erina rie Yesu ribeire amhonyi omoborati ase obotumwa b'abamonoru.
0.hook: Yesu originate risani ekomiti obore b'eng'wencha n'obotumwa bosoni bwi'Erina rie. Acts 2 yoresa bosire obokochi ate okonyorwa kwa abamonoru.

1.title: Bokochi bwabere b'abamonoru
1.explanation: Petero agokora ekegokero kina ati: okwerorera no gotomokwa ase erina ria Yesu Kristo koborwa b'eng'wencha n'okororera egareteire obosani b'obokoreri. Eri Obotumwa Mosoni omonto ogotagogera bwateire ekebwato kionde ki'abamonoru ase eng'ana. Nibochi nomonyone­ti ko omochiere ogotiina orie yamasaba; omonto akomera Kristo oriende obotokwa na obotegete. Erina rinosi nindi omochere, ko niria Kristo originate risani ogosire ase erete obore b'eng'wencha.
1.hook: Petero anyanyi obotokwa, omochiere ogototoreirira ase erina ria Yesu, nekugete obosani bwo Omoyagoro. Acts 8 yomesera eka oborare baronda obotumwa bwi'botumwa bundi gamokeire eJerusalema.

2.title: Erisia rikarereire
2.explanation: Okonyorwa kwa Philipi eSamaria kinoraire abasomi boigesie erina ria Omorobozi Yesu. Acts osgokerere ko Petero na Johana bochire boombi aabamonoru koberi Omoyagoro. Bino biroraire ko omochiere ogototoreirira na koberia Omoyagoro nibo bororera ase Egoro ya Eklesia. Nigo gokeire ko omochiere ogototoreirira ase erina ria Yesu nogokienda ase enyangi emo eJerusalema; ebisimi bekorania abesio abarabera na amasomu ayio amoboko.
2.hook: Abasomi ba Samaria bototoreirie ase erina ria Omorobozi Yesu. Acts 10 yobaririe ko abaloga ogende obotumwa bwi'obosani bobworo na abamogotwa b'obosani.

3.title: Abaloga bochirire
3.explanation: Omoyagoro obororie ase enyomba ya Cornelius mbere y'obototoreirira bwabo. Petero agusoka ogomanya obochamoru bwa Nyasae kwa abaloga, eso okobate omogitoka obototoreirira ase erina ria Omorobozi. Goiko kobasa ko Omoyagoro agochingwa na gireteire na obototoreirira, kana aineneire. Obotumwa Mosoni ogotagogera bwateire omochiere ogototoreirira na koberia Omoyagoro kamanda biobe ase omonyorwa gi'obogitire, kansi gomegesa agoikwa oborende o Egesimi erinya Luke ogoretie.
3.hook: Petero agosoka ogotoka obototoreirira bwa ameire Omoyagoro. Romans yozachia oborere bwa obototoreirira akomanya n'Obochenga bwa Kristo na Okebunia.

4.title: Echengia hamwe na Kristo
4.explanation: Paulo agokora ate abatondeirie Kristo ogototoreirira, nibo abatondeirie obochenga bwabo, nomera kobosani oyio yiondie Kristu originate. Eri ekio ninkomborora oba badge buobora oborere obotari noboru. Omochiere ogototoreirira negesira abatondeirie na obochenga bwa Kristo na okebunia, ne bogongera erindi bwateire omochiere obore oyio kwagera bobe, ne bogochera Kristo originate risani. Paulo anyanya ko omochiere gotari orie kiabonoria, egesimi ko anyanya obochengi hamwe na Kristo originate.
4.hook: Omochiere ogototoreirira anyanisa abatondeirie hamwe na obochenga na okebunia kwa Kristu. Colossians yosongera ekio gotari okuganyera ogora orie gitemanene, igo kwogera ogosubira ase Nyasae.

5.title: Ogora ase kutenda kwa Nyasae
5.explanation: Paulo agokora ate bondeirie hamwe na Kristo ogototoreirira, nobokeire hamwe na yena gotweti kutenda kwa Nyasae ogokeire Jesu originate. Obochengi bwateire Nyasae, okeganyera korairi ekegenderera. Ekionde kiokeinisa omonto gotagokera omochiere gotari merit kana keindagereria ase ogora orie gotari gotegera Kristo. Ebikionde birambwate forgiveness na buya buserete ase gotendera Nyasae aba Kristo.
5.hook: Omochiere ogototoreirira nigo ogora oria orie goseigo ase obochengi bwa Nyasae. Egesimi engina egotekera obototoreirira ase egesa Yesu ekomegotora okobereire omonto origwe eboso na Omoyagoro.
